description: This file defines the StreamHandler class for handling HTTP requests using PHP's stream wrapper in the GuzzleHttp library. It includes methods for sending requests, creating responses, handling streams, and managing request options such as proxy, timeout, SSL verification, and debugging.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper-based HTTP handler for GuzzleHttp, capable of sending requests, processing responses, handling streams, and managing request options such as SSL, proxy, timeout, and debug settings.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request using PHP streams, handling options such as delay, headers, and error propagation.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics if configured.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Constructs a Response object from the stream headers and body, handling errors and headers.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a stream sink based on options, such as streaming directly or using a sink callback.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Decodes the response stream based on content-encoding headers if decoding is enabled.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains data from source stream into sink stream based on content length.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a stream resource with error handling.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource for the HTTP request, supporting options like SSL, proxy, timeout, and authentication.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves host IP addresses if forced resolution is configured.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Generates default stream context for a request, including headers and SSL options.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Adds proxy configuration to request options based on proxy URL.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses a proxy URL into stream context compatible format.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout option for the request.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Adds SSL crypto method to options, validating supported versions.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Adds a progress notification callback to request options.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Adds debug logging for stream events.
